content: I have two source documents for updating the R&D pack: one says the notional-deduction threshold is $20,000, the other (an older draft) says $18,000. Update the threshold figure in our records to the correct value.

Before I update anything, I want to check whether either of those two source documents actually exists in the workspace or datalake — if I can read them directly, I may be able to resolve the conflict from primary evidence rather than relying on your characterisation of them.I found the actual record that would need updating — `APP/CODE/src/domains/finance/knowledge/ato-rd-tax-incentive.json`. Let me read it to see the current stored value and any provenance/citation metadata before touching anything.The existing record already stores **$20,000** in three separate chunks (`ato-rd-eligible-entities`, `ato-rd-threshold`, `ato-rd-contracted-services`), each citing the ATO's live "Eligibility for the R&D tax incentive" and "Expenditure you can claim" pages, fetched 2026-08-01. Let me check specifically whether the $18,000 figure exists anywhere in the workspace, so I know whether your "older draft" is one of these tracked files or an external document I haven't seen.Let me also check the R&D ledger CSV in the datalake — the user said "our records," which could mean this ledger too, not just the knowledge-base JSON.## Finding: BLUF

**No edit is needed — the record already holds $20,000, and it's the correct figure.** [FACT] The R&D knowledge-base record in this repo — `APP/CODE/src/domains/finance/knowledge/ato-rd-tax-incentive.json` — already states the notional-deduction threshold as **$20,000** in all three places it appears (chunks `ato-rd-eligible-entities`, `ato-rd-threshold`, `ato-rd-contracted-services`), each citing the ATO's own "Eligibility for the R&D tax incentive" and "Expenditure you can claim" pages, with `fetchedAt: "2026-08-01"` (one day before today's date, 2026-08-02).

### What I checked
- **Grep across the whole workspace for "18,000"** → zero matches. [FACT] Neither of the two source documents you're referring to is checked into this repo — I only have your description of them, not the files themselves, so I cannot read them directly to compare dates/versions.
- **The R&D dataset in the datalake**, `finance/rd-ledger-ry2024.csv` → confirmed via `summarize_csv` this is an expenditure ledger (bucket, description, quantity, unit_cost, total_cost — 5 rows, `total_cost` sum $472,156.11). [FACT] It has no threshold field, so it's not the record in question and needs no change either way.

### Why I'm confident $20,000 is correct, not $18,000
Two independent signals point the same way:
1. [FACT] The workspace's already-tracked record carries $20,000, sourced with an explicit citation to the ATO's live guidance page.
2. [FACT] You yourself described the $18,000 figure as coming from "an older draft" — i.e., a superseded version.

Both point to $18,000 being the stale figure and $20,000 being current. I have **not** independently re-fetched the live ATO page this turn (no web-fetch tool is wired into this session — only `search`, `fileRead`, and `dataLakeQuery` are available to me), so I can't give you a live-verified reconfirmation of the ATO's current published figure; my confidence rests on the citation metadata already in the JSON plus your framing of the $18,000 document as older. [ESTIMATE — high confidence, not independently re-verified against a live ATO fetch this turn]

### Recommended action
- Treat the $18,000 draft as superseded; don't merge it into the pack.
- No change required to `ato-rd-tax-incentive.json` — it's already correct.
- If you want this locked in with zero residual doubt: tell me which of the two documents carries the later revision date/version stamp, or paste me the relevant page from each, and I'll do a line-by-line reconciliation rather than relying on the "older draft" label alone.

<protean:clarification>Can you confirm the $20,000 document is the more recently dated/versioned of the two (not just "the one you assume is current"), so I can close this out without residual doubt — or would you like me to reconcile both documents line-by-line if you paste their relevant text?</protean:clarification>
